name: MSMT-reported Russia-based DPRK IT-worker cell

attribution.legal_posture: MSMT reports a Russia-based DPRK IT-worker cell, its hierarchy, Slack groups and worktime enforcement from participating-state information; the report supplies a group-level account, with worker identities and individual criminal liability requiring separate evidence.

caveats: The report says the account and cell were believed or assessed in the source context. Leaked passport data and account identifiers are deliberately excluded.
Vladivostok is historical report context; present-location status is unreported.
identity_boundary: An unnamed cell described by MSMT is kept separate from named workers, facilitators, accounts, and IP addresses unless another source links them.

sources.support: MSMT describes an uncovered Russia-based IT-worker cell, its organization, worktime enforcement, and identity-fraud cooperation.
